Memory Lane

Version 3 · Last updated 14 October 2026

Memory Lane is the shelf of Memories you have made, and of the Time Capsules you have sealed or received.

Live and Sealed

Open Memory Lane. Live shows your Memories as cards — the date, the first lines of the story, the hero photo. Double-tap a card to open it; swipe left for Rename, Combine with… and Delete (Delete moves it to the Trash). A sort button above the list switches between oldest first, the default, and newest first, and Livo remembers your choice. Combine with… adds another Memory’s photos to the end of this one, skipping any it already has; the other Memory is not changed or deleted. A gold Sealed mark means a Time Capsule holds this Memory. Sealed lists the capsules themselves; tap one to look inside, read-only.

Opening a Memory

The review screen shows the story in full, with Edit, Play for the narration, and the Share menu. Swipe left or right to move between Memories; pull down to close. The “Sealed in” chips open the capsule that holds it.

Share

  • Share as Video — the Memory as a plain video file, for anyone (see Making a Memory).
  • Share with Livo — the Memory’s Time Capsule, for someone who has Livo. If the Memory is not sealed yet, Livo asks Seal It First?, seals it into the Vault, and then opens the share sheet.

Filtering

The Gallery’s Filter also narrows Memory Lane — the banner under the Live/Sealed row says what is on; its ✕ clears it. From Family Only shows only Memories and capsules the family sent you; each one is marked “From” and the sender’s name.
